JSON-Schema-Test-Suite 89e83a74014617ffbe79a56d83d14d054cd11417 2026-10-21, draft7, required tests: 258 cases, 929 tests.

Each test's document is decoded into the type generated from its schema, as JSON and as YAML.
A root that is only a $ref gets no type of its own, so its documents are decoded as the
required property of a schema that refers to it.
A missing check accepts a document the suite marks invalid, and a wrong rejection rejects one
it marks valid. A missing check is silent when its case has no generator warning.
